verdict.line: You lose if Garen lands Q's silence into a level 6+ all-in while you're already under half HP; you win almost every trade once E is up and his Q is down.

brief.thesis: Darius's E (Apprehend) is the one tool in this matchup Garen has no answer for — it drags him back into range and removes his ability to disengage from a fight he's losing, while Darius's passive (Hemorrhage) stacking wins any extended trade Garen agrees to. Garen's only real counters are landing Q's silence before Darius starts his combo, and burying him with R (Demacian Justice) once level 6 hits. Outside of those two windows, Darius simply out-trades him.

theirWindow.when: Level 6+ with Q and R both up
theirWindow.what: Once Garen hits level 6 his all-in spikes hard: Q silences you so you can't E, W, or R back, E (Judgment) shreds your armor, and R executes a big chunk of true damage off missing health. If you're below ~60% HP and he has Q and R both available, disengage instead of trading — you cannot out-silence a silence.

yourWindow.what: The moment you have E, look to pull Garen mid-wave while his Q is on cooldown — without the silence he has no way to interrupt your E into W into auto into Q sequence, and your passive stacks snowball the trade decisively in your favor.

start.why: The lifesteal rewards fighting often and offsets Garen's own out-of-combat passive regen (Perseverance) during early skirmishes.

boots.why: Every point of Garen's damage is physical — autos, E (Judgment) spin, and R — so flat armor blunts his entire kit, not just one instance.

core.why: Gives the burst, attack speed, and movement speed to land E into W into auto into Q before he can spin away or reposition.
Stacks armor shred on top of Garen's own E shred, letting your true damage and autos punch through whatever tank items he buys.
The HP and damage-scaling shield keeps you alive through his Q silence window and stops a single burst rotation from finishing you.

situational.when: you are ahead and want to keep dueling through his follow-up damage without dying to delayed burst
he has snowballed and threatens to kill you in one all-in rotation before backup arrives
he rushes health-stacking bruiser items and becomes hard to burst down in extended fights

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the sustained trading and extended all-ins that Darius wants — stack it during your E-W-auto-Q sequence and the healing offsets Garen's own sustain.

summoners.why: Ignite shuts off Garen's passive (Perseverance) regen between skirmishes and turns your trades into permanent HP loss; Flash covers E's max range or escapes a bad R.

playing.title: Trade Only After E
playing.detail: Don't commit with just Q or W before level 2 — without E you can't stop Garen from walking away or punishing you with his own Q silence.

playing.title: Pull Mid-Wave, Not Immediately
playing.detail: Land E when minions are near so he can't cleanly disengage, and time it for when his Q (Decisive Strike) is on cooldown so he has no silence to interrupt your combo.

playing.title: Stack Passive Before Committing R
playing.detail: Land Q edge hits and autos to build 5 stacks of Hemorrhage first — your R's execute threshold and true damage jump hugely at max stacks.

playing.title: Respect The Level 6 Spike
playing.detail: Once Garen hits 6, don't stand in melee range below roughly 60% HP; his Q into E into R can kill through a CS lead if he lands the silence first.

playing.title: Watch For The Silence Tell
playing.detail: Garen must activate Q before his next auto silences — if you see that buff icon light up, back off or bait it out rather than eating a free silence into his all-in.

playing.title: Ignite Breaks His Sustain
playing.detail: Garen's passive heals him hard out of combat between skirmishes — Ignite removes that safety net and makes every trade you win stick.

playing.title: Don't Chase Under Turret
playing.detail: His E and R reward him for standing and fighting, not fleeing, so if he dives under his tower to reset, let him go instead of trading into tower shots plus a spin.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names drift patch to patch and my knowledge has a cutoff — confirm Trinity Force, Black Cleaver, Conqueror, and the exact rune shards still exist and behave this way in your current client before locking in the build.
